To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel method to construct a boundary tree that approximates a complicated deep learning model.

we propose a new approach that allows users to interpret a complicated deep learning model by disclosing a small set of representative training data, and we show that this approach is more efficient and effective than other existing methods.
we present a method to disclose only a small set of data points from training data for a deep learning model.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (1) How to select a small set of representative training data to approximate a deep learning model?
how to make a black box model transparent to users and how to make a complicated model understandable to users.
the question of how to share a deep learning model with users in a way that is transparent and interpretable, without sharing the training data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

our method is able to construct a boundary tree with high accuracy and fidelity using a small set of carefully selected data points, which can then be used to approximate a deep learning model and provide users a better understanding of the underlying model and its predictions.
our proposed method is a new and promising approach to interpret deep neural networks.
our method can help the users to understand the model better and gain trust in the model, which is the main purpose of the model interpretation and explanation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a method for model sharing that enables users to get a better understanding of a shared model without the need to disclose the training data.
our proposed approach is able to disclose a small subset of training data that can be sufficient for users to better understand a complicated model and gain trust in model predictions.
we are trying to find a way to share the training data in such a way that it would not violate any privacy policy but still provide the user enough information about how the model is trained.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a deep learning model can be interpreted using a small set of data points that is just sufficient to understand the model behavior.
a boundary tree is a good surrogate model for the blackbox model, and it can be used as an explication for a complicated model.
the boundary tree can be used as an effective way of model interpretation and model sharing.
